verdict.rationale: LiveKit publishes first-party self-hosting deployment docs covering the embedded TURN server and domain/SSL requirements. A hands-on probe booted the Apache-2.0 `livekit-server` locally with no account or key, and the agents framework itself installs from PyPI with no key. missing for 10: hands-on or documented evidence of a production-grade self-hosted agent deployment (only dev mode was verified), and confirmation of which features (e.g., LiveKit Inference, Agent Builder) remain cloud-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The good news is LiveKit includes an embedded TURN server. It's a secure TURN implementation that has integrated authentication with the rest of LiveKit.
In order to have a secure LiveKit deployment, you will need a domain as well as a SSL certificate for that domain.
`livekit-server --dev` (brew-installed, Apache-2.0 OSS) booted on this machine with NO account or key
pypi livekit-agents 1.8.0 installs and `import livekit.agents` succeeds with no key
LiveKit is an open-source platform for building voice, video, and physical AI agents.
